incidents.vector: Linux implants (BPFdoor variants, Rekoobe, AVERAT) deployed on network appliances mimicking legitimate Korean and Taiwanese email security hardware.
incidents.impact: Ongoing covert access to telecommunications infrastructure across Asia-Pacific; implants designed for persistent access and traffic interception.

incidents.victim: Critical infrastructure (water, telecom, government, higher education)
incidents.vector: Exploitation of unpatched Microsoft SharePoint vulnerabilities; security software disabled across dozens of hosts before Warlock ransomware deployment.
incidents.impact: Water utility, telecom provider, university, and regional government in Portuguese- and Spanish-speaking countries across Europe, Africa, and Latin America hit; campaign ongoing into 2026.

incidents.vector: Ransomware deployed against city government systems; specific attack vector under investigation.
incidents.impact: City computer systems shut down affecting utility payment processing; FBI and DHS engaged. Emergency services unaffected; 20,000 residents impacted.

incidents.vector: Exploitation of a smart contract vulnerability in the NEAR Intents cross-chain swap service.
incidents.impact: Over $3.8 million in cryptocurrency assets stolen.

incidents.victim: Global banking sector, Qatar national ID system, Swedish Tax Agency
incidents.vector: Critical RCE vulnerability (CVE-2026-18397, CVSS 9.4) in the SConnect browser extension used to authenticate into SWIFT banking infrastructure, Qatar's Tawtheeq national ID system, and Sweden's Skatteverket tax agency.
incidents.impact: Over 1 million Chrome Web Store users exposed to remote code execution risk with direct access to critical financial and government authentication systems. Patched Aug–Sep 2026; no confirmed exploitation disclosed.

incidents.victim: Air Traffic and Navigation Services (ATNS), South Africa
incidents.vector: Ransomware deployed against ATNS operational technology network providing weather services to air traffic controllers; possible insider involvement under investigation.
incidents.impact: Attack stopped before full disruption, but ATNS confirmed it could have crippled South African and international air travel. ATNS manages approximately 6% of the world's airspace.

incidents.vector: Autonomous AI agent exploited a vulnerability in DIVD's systems without human direction.
incidents.impact: DIVD systems breached in a reported first-of-kind successful AI-autonomous attack on a cybersecurity organization; investigation ongoing.

incidents.victim: Enterprises and government, North America and Europe
incidents.vector: Exploitation of two critical Citrix NetScaler zero-days (CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772, CVSS 9.5) enabling remote code execution; CVE-2026-88772 exploited undetected for at least 3 weeks before disclosure.
incidents.impact: Dozens of organizations in government, financial services, education, telecom, and professional services confirmed compromised; novel tunneler malware used for internal reconnaissance and credential theft. CISA added both CVEs to KEV; exploitation ongoing.

incidents.vector: Previously unknown critical vulnerability in Kiteworks Advanced Forms product; US federal authorities issued credible threat intelligence warning of imminent targeted exploitation.
incidents.impact: ~50 organizations preemptively took production systems offline; vulnerability patched with no confirmed exploitation. Federal warning indicates organized threat actor interest in the secure file transfer platform.

incidents.victim: FBI, higher education, healthcare, technology, agriculture, transportation, and government organizations (dozens)
incidents.vector: Mass exploitation of Oracle PeopleSoft vulnerability (CVE-2026-35273) across dozens of organizations; FBI jobs portal apply.fbijobs.gov breached and defaced.
incidents.impact: SSNs, job titles, psychiatric and medical records of 5,000+ FBI officials stolen. Dozens of organizations across multiple sectors compromised in the same mass exploitation campaign.

incidents.vector: Triple zero-day exploit chain: two Chrome JavaScript engine RCE flaws (CVE-2026-85046, CVE-2026-87491) and a Windows ALPC privilege-escalation zero-day (CVE-2026-85880) delivered via phishing emails with pro-democracy lure themes.
incidents.impact: Asian government entities compromised using CLEANGULP malware. Multiple China-aligned groups sharing the same exploit kit suggest coordinated offensive activity; full scope broader than currently reported.

incidents.vector: Unauthorized file-sharing server maintained undetected for approximately 9 months, providing persistent access to US military personnel records.
incidents.impact: Data on 3.1 million current and former US military personnel exposed (2.8 million living, 294,000 deceased), including personally identifiable information for a significant portion of the US military workforce.

incidents.victim: Government ministries in Taiwan, India, Philippines, Cambodia, Pakistan, Thailand, Myanmar, Syria
incidents.vector: Rust-based backdoor ('Antino') deployed on 350+ endpoints across eight national governments over a 10-month campaign (September 2025 – July 2026), likely via spear-phishing.
incidents.impact: Long-term covert access to government networks across eight Asian and Middle Eastern countries; 350+ endpoints compromised with persistent backdoor access.

incidents.vector: Social engineering of an Odido employee to obtain credentials and access the customer database.
incidents.impact: Personal data of 6.2 million Dutch citizens (approximately one-third of the Netherlands' population) stolen. ShinyHunters claimed responsibility; one member subsequently arrested in the Netherlands.

incidents.victim: US industrial automation and SCADA vendor (unnamed) and its critical infrastructure customers
incidents.vector: Foreign actors breached a US industrial automation and SCADA vendor, exfiltrating customer data including ICS device configurations and network details for downstream critical infrastructure operators.
incidents.impact: SCADA operational data and ICS device details for US power utilities and transportation entities stolen. CISA and FBI issued joint advisory in 2026 warning critical infrastructure operators who procured from the affected vendor.
